recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-36258 in the core FHIR checkout unless a future terminology publication process regenerates the CodeSystem with different wording.
issue_request: FHIR-36258 was a Published/Persuasive Vocab change request for the normative concept-property-type CodeSystem. It asked to correct the integer concept definition from "The property value is a string (often used to assign ranking values to concepts for supporting score assessments)." to "The property value is an integer (often used to assign ranking values to concepts for supporting score assessments)."
initial_application: The Jira comment records application in git 7d14a40e53. That commit changed source/codesystem/codesystem-concept-property-type.xml from "a string" to "an integer" in both the then-checked-in narrative table and the CodeSystem concept definition.
additional_context: The current source has since been refactored so the authoritative CodeSystem XML remains without the old checked-in narrative table. CodeSystem is an active resource in source/fhir.ini, and source/codesystem/structuredefinition-CodeSystem.xml binds CodeSystem.property.type to ValueSet/concept-property-type. Community searches found no conflicting Zulip or Confluence evidence; the only Confluence reference found is Vocab WGM minutes describing application of FHIR-36258.
reconciliation: No source change was made because source/codesystem/codesystem-concept-property-type.xml line 65 already contains the corrected integer wording, and a source-wide search found no remaining stale "a string" ranking-values definition.
